investor_name: Global Environment Facility (GEF — incl. LDCF & SCCF)

template.title: UNFCCC / Multilateral Climate Fund Concept Note & Funding Proposal
template.governing_standard: GCF Investment Framework / GEF-9 / CIF AMPLIFi / Adaptation Fund Direct Access Standards
template.typical_review_timeline: 3–9 months (Concept Note -> Accredited Entity Review -> Board Decision)

fields.label: Proposal Title & Implementing Organization
fields.description: Full proposal title, executing entity, and host country.

fields.label: Accredited Entity (AE) / Direct Access Entity (DAE) Channel
fields.description: Identifies whether applicant can submit directly or must channel through an Accredited Entity (e.g., EBRD, World Bank, TSKB, BNDES).

fields.label: National Designated Authority (NDA) / Operational Focal Point No-Objection
fields.description: Mandatory host-country NDA or Focal Point endorsement verification.

fields.label: Target Climate Fund Window & Concessional Instrument
fields.description: Selects grant, concessional loan, catalytic first-loss, or guarantee window aligned with fund mandate.

fields.label: Co-Financing Ratio & Catalytic Mobilization Plan
fields.description: Shows how concessional climate fund capital crowds in public/private co-financing.

fields.label: Paradigm Shift & Systemic Scalability Potential
fields.description: Explains replicability, market transformation, and COP31 scaling-up pathway.

fields.label: Climate Rationale & Financial Additionality
fields.description: Demonstrates why concessional climate finance is strictly necessary and cannot be fully met by commercial markets.

fields.label: Expected Mitigation (tCO2e) &/or Adaptation Beneficiaries
fields.description: Quantified lifetime GHG savings and direct/indirect resilience beneficiaries.

fields.label: Gender Action Plan & Environmental/Social Safeguards
fields.description: Documents gender responsiveness, inclusive benefits, and E&S compliance.

fields.label: MRV Monitoring Framework & Post-Funding Sustainability
fields.description: Measurement, Reporting & Verification (MRV) plan and long-term commercial/institutional exit strategy.

fields.label: Funding Proposal Executive Summary
fields.description: Decision-ready summary mapped to the climate fund's COP31 priorities.
